articles.summary: Voice input for any app. Your users speak, and the Dictation API returns text that’s ready to send: filler gone, self-corrections resolved, names spelled right. Fast, accurate, and 19 languages.
articles.title: Introducing the Dictation API: the first API built for dictation

articles.summary: Universal-3.5 Pro is live on OpenRouter, served by the AssemblyAI Sync API. One POST to /audio/transcriptions returns a finished transcript, with prompting, conversation context, and keyterms passed through. No markup on our published rates.
articles.title: Universal-3.5 Pro is now on OpenRouter
